minecraft:terracotta: Hardened clay made by smelting a clay block, and found in huge layers in badlands. It is tougher than clay and resists explosions fairly well. Craft eight around a dye to color it.
minecraft:packed_ice: Ice compressed so tightly it never melts, found in icebergs and ice spikes. Craft nine ice into one. It is slippery, and nine packed ice make blue ice.
minecraft:dirt_path: A flattened path made by using a shovel on grass or dirt. It sits slightly lower than other blocks and is common in villages. It turns back into dirt if a solid block is placed on top.
minecraft:sunflower: A tall yellow flower that always faces east, handy for finding your way. Craft it into two yellow dye. Bone meal on it drops another sunflower.
minecraft:lilac: A tall flowering bush with purple blooms. Craft it into two magenta dye. Bone meal on it drops another lilac.
minecraft:rose_bush: A tall bush covered in red roses. Craft it into two red dye. Bone meal on it drops another rose bush.
minecraft:peony: A tall bush with large pink blooms. Craft it into two pink dye. Bone meal on it drops another peony.
minecraft:tall_grass: Grass that grows two blocks tall. Breaking it sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears.
minecraft:large_fern: A fern that grows two blocks tall, common in taigas. Breaking it sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears.

minecraft:prismarine: A teal stone that slowly shifts color, found in ocean monuments. Craft four prismarine shards into one. It has stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:prismarine_bricks: Neat teal bricks from ocean monuments. Craft nine prismarine shards into one block. They have stairs and slabs.
minecraft:dark_prismarine: A dark teal stone from ocean monuments. Craft eight prismarine shards around black dye. It has stairs and slabs.
minecraft:prismarine_stairs: Stairs made of prismarine. Craft six prismarine in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. Their color slowly shifts like the original block.
minecraft:prismarine_brick_stairs: Stairs made of prismarine bricks. Craft six bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit ocean-themed builds.
minecraft:dark_prismarine_stairs: Stairs made of dark prismarine. Craft six blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit deep ocean builds.
minecraft:sea_lantern: A glowing block found in ocean monuments and ruins. It gives off full light, even under water. Craft it from prismarine shards and crystals; without Silk Touch it drops crystals.
minecraft:red_sandstone: Sandstone made from red sand, found under badlands. Craft four red sand into one. It can be cut, chiseled or smoothed.
minecraft:chiseled_red_sandstone: Red sandstone carved with a wither-like pattern. Craft two red sandstone slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.
minecraft:cut_red_sandstone: Red sandstone cut into a clean, banded block. Craft four red sandstone into four, or use a stonecutter. It has its own slabs.
minecraft:red_sandstone_stairs: Stairs made of red sandstone. Craft six red sandstone in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit badlands builds.
minecraft:repeating_command_block: A command block that runs its command every game tick while active. It can only be obtained with commands in Creative mode. Map makers use it for constant checks and effects.
minecraft:chain_command_block: A command block that runs after the command block pointing into it. It can only be obtained with commands in Creative mode. Map makers use it to run commands in order.
minecraft:magma_block: A glowing block from the Nether that burns anything standing on it, unless they sneak. Craft four magma cream into one. Under water it creates bubble columns that pull things down.
minecraft:nether_wart_block: A red, fleshy block from crimson forest trees. Craft nine nether wart into one. A hoe breaks it fastest.
minecraft:warped_wart_block: A teal, fleshy block from warped forest trees. It can't be crafted. A hoe breaks it fastest.
minecraft:red_nether_bricks: Dark red bricks made from nether wart and nether bricks. Craft two of each into one block. They have stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:bone_block: A block made of nine bone meal, found in fossils underground and in the Nether. Craft it back into nine bone meal. It makes a pale, ribbed building block.
minecraft:structure_void: An invisible block used with structure blocks. It marks spaces that saved structures should leave untouched. It can only be obtained with commands.
